definitions.definition_verbatim: Female deer, fawns of either sex other than spotted fawns, and male deer with an unbranched antler on one or both sides which is not more than three inches in length (T14 CCR §351(b)).
Antlerless deer, or legal bucks that have two or more points in the upper two-thirds of either antler (T14 CCR §351(c)).

A male deer having a branched antler on either side with the branch in the upper two-thirds of the antler. Eyeguards or other bony projections on the lower one-third of the antler shall not be considered as points or branches (T14 CCR §351(a)).
A male deer with unbranched antlers on both sides which are more than 3 inches in length (FGC 200(a)(2)).

spike_rule.headline: A spike buck is not legal on either tag.
spike_rule.explanation: A spike buck has unbranched antlers longer than three inches. That makes it neither a forked-horn buck (which requires a branched antler) nor an antlerless deer (which allows an unbranched antler of not more than three inches). A spike is not a doe — taking one on an antlerless or either-sex tag is not legal.

classes.label: Premium
classes.definition_verbatim: Are any hunt where the quota filled on or before the first business day after July 1, of the previous year.
classes.how_issued_verbatim: Premium deer tags are issued by drawing.
classes.limit_verbatim: Hunters may only obtain one premium hunt tag per license year.

citation.source_doc: CDFW Big Game Hunting Digest p.16: 2026 Big Game Digest 6.15_int.pdf

classes.label: Restricted
classes.definition_verbatim: Are any hunt that filled on or before the first business day after August 1 of the previous year.
classes.how_issued_verbatim: Restricted tags are issued upon request until the tag quota for the hunt is filled.

citation.source_doc: CDFW Big Game Hunting Digest p.17: 2026 Big Game Digest 6.15_int.pdf

classes.label: Unrestricted
classes.definition_verbatim: Are any hunt that did not fill on or before the first business day after August 1, in the previous year.
classes.how_issued_verbatim: Unrestricted deer hunt tags are issued upon request until tag quotas fill.

events.title: Big Game Drawing deadline
events.verbatim: All sales transactions for the Big Game Drawing must be completed before midnight on June 2, 2026.
events.consequence: Miss this and you cannot be drawn for a premium deer tag this license year.

events.title: Drawing results posted
events.verbatim: Applicants may look up their drawing results on or around June 15, 2026 by entering their customer information on CDFW’s website at licenses.wildlife.ca.gov/InternetSales and click on “View My Draw Application/Preference Points” at the top of the page.

events.title: Leftover premium tags — first-deer tag
events.verbatim: A First-Deer Tag may be used to obtain the following: • Restricted Deer Hunt Tags • Unrestricted Deer Hunt Tags • Leftover Premium Deer Hunt Tags issued on July 2, 2026.
events.detail_verbatim: If any premium deer hunt tags remain after the Big Game Drawing, First-Deer Tag applicants may apply for any leftover premium deer hunt tags starting at 8:00 a.m.
events.consequence: A second chance at a premium tag if you were not drawn.

citation.source_doc: CDFW Big Game Hunting Digest p.17: 2026 Big Game Digest 6.15_int.pdf

events.title: Leftover premium tags — second-deer tag
events.verbatim: A Second-Deer Tag may be used to obtain the following: • Unrestricted Deer Hunt Tags • Restricted Deer Hunt Tags • Leftover Premium Deer Hunt Tags issued on August 2, 2026.
events.consequence: A second chance at a premium tag on your second-deer tag.

citation.source_doc: CDFW Big Game Hunting Digest p.17: 2026 Big Game Digest 6.15_int.pdf

events.title: Deer tag harvest report due
events.verbatim: Deer tag holders who fail to submit a harvest report for any 2026 deer tag by January 31, 2027, will be assessed a non-reporting fee when purchasing a deer tag drawing application or deer tag in the 2027 license year.
events.consequence: A non-reporting fee is added when you buy next year's tag — and it applies even if you did not hunt.
